title: DUNGEON CRAWLER CARL
subtitle: WORLD DUNGEON / BOOK ONE ARCHIVE
footer: UNOFFICIAL FAN BROADCAST / ENGLISH STORY RECAP

book1_fr.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl, Book 1 — French edition supplied by user
book1_fr.reference: PDF page numbers are one-based, counting front matter. Chapter 48 denotes the epilogue.

editorial_policy.method: Original English paraphrases of checked passages in the supplied French translation; not quotations from the English edition.
editorial_policy.scope: Book 1, including its epilogue. Future-floor warnings are included only as disclosed in Book 1.
editorial_policy.names: Descriptive English labels are used for translated items and some bosses when the exact English-edition title has not been checked.
editorial_policy.statistics: Values are snapshots tied to their cited scene, never live or randomized.

cards.headline: One escaped cat. Two survivors.
cards.body: Donut slips out of the window. Carl goes outside to retrieve her, leaving both of them clear of the building when it collapses.
cards.subject: CARL + DONUT

cards.headline: Marine tech. Reluctant hero.
cards.body: Carl is a 27-year-old Coast Guard veteran working on boat electrical systems in Seattle. He was looking after his ex-girlfriend's cat.
cards.subject: CARL

cards.headline: Royalty has paperwork.
cards.body: Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk is Beatrice's prizewinning tortoiseshell Persian. Her trophies and photographs fill a room.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: Your planet has been claimed.
cards.body: Borant announces Earth's reclamation under Syndicate rules. Survivors are offered entry into an eighteen-floor World Dungeon.
cards.subject: BORANT / SYNDICATE

cards.headline: The entrance will not wait.
cards.body: The initial announcement allows one hour to enter. With Seattle freezing and shelter gone, Carl runs toward a warm, glowing dungeon entrance.
cards.subject: EARTH SURVIVORS

cards.headline: The cat registered first.
cards.body: Donut is crawler 4119. Carl is crawler 4122. Their initial profiles have no class; race and class selection comes at the third floor.
cards.subject: CARL + DONUT

cards.headline: First cat through the door.
cards.body: Carl receives a legendary pet box for being the first crawler to enter with a cat. His other entry achievements award additional boxes.
cards.subject: CARL

cards.headline: That sign is a trap.
cards.body: A sign advertising a tutorial guild leads Carl into a goblin ambush. He loses his pink Crocs while fleeing the goblins' machine.
cards.subject: CARL + DONUT

cards.headline: A guide with experience.
cards.body: Carl reaches Mordecai's tutorial guild. On this floor, its level-50 guildmaster appears as a rat-like noncombatant NPC.
cards.subject: MORDECAI

cards.headline: Safe does not stop the clock.
cards.body: Entering the tutorial guild puts Carl in a safe zone. The notification explicitly warns that the floor countdown keeps running.
cards.subject: TUTORIAL GUILD

cards.headline: Survival is television.
cards.body: Mordecai explains that Borant profits from broadcasting the crawl. Carl realizes he has become a contestant in an alien reality show.
cards.subject: BORANT

cards.headline: Open your loot somewhere safe.
cards.body: Loot boxes can only be opened in safe zones. Mordecai warns Carl to read each item's properties before equipping or using it.
cards.subject: LOOT BOXES

cards.headline: A very unstable delivery.
cards.body: Carl's silver goblin box contains five sticks of dynamite, a lighter and a goblin pass. The pass brands his forearm.
cards.subject: CARL

cards.headline: Do not leave treats unattended.
cards.body: Carl's legendary pet box supplies 500 ordinary pet biscuits and one enhanced biscuit. Donut snatches the enhanced one and begins transforming.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: Your cat has opinions now.
cards.body: Donut emerges from the transformation able to speak. The system now treats her as a full crawler rather than a pet.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: Charm is not armor.
cards.body: After the biscuit, Donut has 25 Charisma but only 2 Constitution. Her growth buff adds Strength, Intelligence and Charisma when she levels.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: Magic comes with a manual.
cards.body: Donut learns Magic Missile from a spell tome in a silver adventurer box. The tome teaches it permanently; scrolls provide one use.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: The crown has consequences.
cards.body: Donut equips her crown before Mordecai finishes warning her. It puts her in the Blood Sultanate succession on floor nine, even if removed.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: The cat outranks you.
cards.body: Donut names their party the Royal Court of Princess Donut and gives Carl a royal bodyguard title. Her higher combined stats make her leader.
cards.subject: ROYAL COURT

cards.headline: A room and a hot meal.
cards.body: Carl and Donut find a restaurant safe room staffed by Tally, a bopca caretaker. Its display lists sleeping rooms at zero gold.
cards.subject: TALLY

cards.headline: This boss was a person.
cards.body: Their first boss is the level-7 Hoarder, a terrified human transformed into a giant. The arena locks after Carl and Donut enter.
cards.subject: THE HOARDER

cards.headline: The first victory hurts.
cards.body: Carl uses a dog chain and his fists while Donut fires Magic Missile. They defeat the Hoarder, but Carl is shaken by killing her.
cards.subject: ROYAL COURT

cards.headline: A victory that charts the way.
cards.body: Mordecai explains that neighborhood bosses drop a neighborhood map. Defeating one also earns a bronze boss box and a bronze star.
cards.subject: BOSS REWARDS

cards.headline: More light. Less enthusiasm.
cards.body: Donut learns the Torch spell from her bronze boss box. It creates a light that follows her; she is far less pleased than Carl and Mordecai.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: A deal with the goblins.
cards.body: Carl trades drugs and information to Rory and Lorelai for transport, fuel and a grenade. Donut's influence helps close the bargain.
cards.subject: RORY + LORELAI

cards.headline: The stairs are not for everyone.
cards.body: Rory tells Carl that dungeon mobs die if they descend the stairs. She cannot simply join the crawlers and leave her floor.
cards.subject: RORY

cards.headline: Victory with a terrible cost.
cards.body: The explosion kills the goblin boss. Only afterward does Carl learn that families and babies were inside; the victory leaves him horrified.
cards.subject: GOBLIN BOSS ROOM

cards.headline: Frank's story falls apart.
cards.body: Frank claims his partner is dead. Maggie then emerges to help ambush Carl and Donut, exposing the lie.
cards.subject: FRANK Q + MAGGIE MY

cards.headline: Let the safe room do its job.
cards.body: Frank and Maggie attack inside a safe room and are frozen by the system. Carl anticipated the penalty and escapes with Donut.
cards.subject: CARL + DONUT

cards.headline: Meet the people worth saving.
cards.body: Carl meets Meadow Lark's residents and staff: Brandon, Chris, Yolanda and Imani. A fire evacuation had put them outside before the collapse.
cards.subject: TEAM MEADOW LARK

cards.headline: Skulls do not tell the whole story.
cards.body: Imani's profile carries twelve crawler-kill markers. Brandon explains she ended patients' suffering during an attack rather than leave them burning.
cards.subject: IMANI

cards.headline: Some choose to stay.
cards.body: Thirty residents shelter in a Waffle House safe room. They vote to remain there instead of continuing the crawl.
cards.subject: MEADOW LARK RESIDENTS

cards.headline: Do not skip the boss fight.
cards.body: The gym's level-9 boss throws heavy weights. When it grabs Carl, Donut attacks with teeth and claws to break its hold.
cards.subject: GYM BOSS

cards.headline: The enemy is a whole crowd.
cards.body: The rolling area boss is a mass of tusked orcs. Carl's group fights from a makeshift shelter until the ball breaks apart into individual enemies.
cards.subject: AREA BOSS

cards.headline: A route down for Meadow Lark.
cards.body: After the area boss falls, Carl and Donut agree to scout ahead and find safe shelter for the residents on the next floor.
cards.subject: CARL + DONUT

cards.headline: Donut knows this stage.
cards.body: Taken to a production trailer for Odette's show, Donut asks about makeup, tone and presentation. Carl leaves the interview preparation to her.
cards.subject: ODETTE'S SHOW

cards.headline: Stay recognizable.
cards.body: Odette advises Donut to remain a cat when race selection arrives. She warns that changing a popular crawler's appearance can cost them fans.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: A new floor. Another staircase.
cards.body: Carl and Donut enter floor two before the first floor collapses. They soon spot a staircase to floor three on the map.
cards.subject: CARL + DONUT

cards.headline: The cleanup crew grows.
cards.body: Floor two's larvae eat corpses and grow toward more dangerous forms. Carl starts destroying remains, hoping to deny them food.
cards.subject: FLOOR 2 LARVAE

cards.headline: One clone. Too many tentacles.
cards.body: The level-10 Krakaren clone attacks with tentacles. Carl makes an immunity drink while Donut holds off the smaller enemies.
cards.subject: KRAKAREN CLONE

cards.headline: The bodyguard needs rescuing.
cards.body: After the Krakaren fight, Carl is critically injured. Donut drags him clear of the fire and heals him once the healing-blocking effect ends.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: Grooming with actual benefits.
cards.body: Donut's enchanted grooming brush adds 2 Constitution for thirty hours if someone brushes her for at least ten minutes.
cards.subject: PRINCESS DONUT

cards.headline: Less time than expected.
cards.body: Mordecai had expected up to ten days for floor two. The crawlers receive six; he says five days is the legal minimum.
cards.subject: FLOOR 2

cards.headline: Your publicist has arrived.
cards.body: Borant assigns Zev to manage Carl and Donut's interview requests. She is a kua-tin administrator from its communications department.
cards.subject: ZEV

cards.headline: A surprisingly familiar fandom.
cards.body: Zev and Donut discover they both know Gossip Girl. The shared interest quickly turns their official meeting into an animated conversation.
cards.subject: ZEV + DONUT

cards.headline: Killing them makes more.
cards.body: Mordecai explains that corpses trigger more cleanup larvae. Destroying the bodies prevents feeding, but does not prevent spawning.
cards.subject: CLEANUP SYSTEM

cards.headline: The punishment arrives.
cards.body: Jack urinates in a dungeon corridor, triggering a level-93 rage elemental. The residents' evacuation turns into a desperate flight.
cards.subject: RAGE ELEMENTAL

cards.headline: Yolanda stands her ground.
cards.body: Yolanda stays beside the fallen Randall despite the danger. The rage elemental kills them both as the others flee.
cards.subject: YOLANDA + RANDALL

cards.headline: Carl goes back for Elle.
cards.body: The elemental reverses gravity. Carl reaches Elle McGibbons, carries her through the chaos and gets her inside the safe room.
cards.subject: ELLE McGIBBONS

cards.headline: Safe rooms now close early.
cards.body: A new announcement says safe spaces will close one hour before each floor collapses. Crawlers still inside will be teleported out.
cards.subject: SYSTEM RULE CHANGE

cards.headline: The mother is a launcher.
cards.body: Carl names their escape device Mother of All Bombs. It launches smaller bombs from a trailer while Donut operates it behind the goblin bike.
cards.subject: CARL + DONUT

cards.headline: Let the dungeon kill it.
cards.body: Carl lures the rage elemental toward the stairs. Donut teleports them clear; the monster slides into the stairwell and is destroyed by dungeon rules.
cards.subject: RAGE ELEMENTAL

cards.headline: A very different booking.
cards.body: While Zev is suspended, Mukta overrides her planned interview and sends Carl and Donut to Death Watch instead.
cards.subject: MUKTA

cards.headline: Carl interrupts the spectacle.
cards.body: On Death Watch, Carl offers to join the danger facing Li Jun's group and challenges the host, turning the audience against the show's setup.
cards.subject: CARL

cards.headline: The trap had another victim.
cards.body: Death Watch reveals that Carl's trap injured Frank and Maggie's daughter, Yvette. Carl had not known she was with them.
cards.subject: YVETTE

cards.headline: Boots are no longer the answer.
cards.body: The host gives Carl combat boots and socks as a taunt. Carl declines to wear them because several of his abilities depend on bare feet.
cards.subject: CARL

cards.headline: A gift for the wrong people.
cards.body: The host gives Frank and Maggie a legendary skill potion that can raise Find Crawler to level 15, enabling searches for crawlers by name.
cards.subject: FRANK Q + MAGGIE MY

cards.headline: Zev wins her appeal.
cards.body: Zev returns after appealing her suspension for warning them about the elemental. She apologizes for the Death Watch booking.
cards.subject: ZEV

cards.headline: A biscuit changes the fight.
cards.body: Carl feeds the fourteen injured dingos in the kobold kennels. They turn non-hostile and later attack their kobold captors when the cages open.
cards.subject: CAPTIVE DINGOS

cards.headline: Do not underestimate the gerbil.
cards.body: Ralph is the kennel's level-11 boss. A dingo swallows him, but he survives; Carl finally stuns and crushes him.
cards.subject: RALPH

cards.headline: One key. One companion.
cards.body: A key opens the captive animals' cages, but breaks after one use by a non-kobold. Donut chooses the pink-feathered mongoliensis.
cards.subject: PET REWARD ROOM

cards.headline: Meet the tiny menace.
cards.body: Donut names the male mongoliensis Mongo. He is a level-1 pet-class mob, but has not bonded with her and keeps trying to bite.
cards.subject: MONGO

cards.headline: Even Mongo must obey the rules.
cards.body: Mongo tries to bite Carl in Mordecai's safe room and is teleported outside. Carl and Donut find him crying in the main corridor.
cards.subject: MONGO

cards.headline: Practice beats popularity.
cards.body: Zev asks Carl to stop using his boring slingshot. He keeps training and learns to knock flying hornets down for Donut to finish.
cards.subject: CARL

cards.headline: Mongo joins the court.
cards.body: Donut rescues Mongo from a hornet. His map marker turns orange, and the system registers him as her bonded pet and a member of the party.
cards.subject: MONGO + DONUT

cards.headline: Choose the next version of you.
cards.body: Mordecai explains the next step: race selection, then class selection, followed by stat allocation. Donut's growth buff restricts her allocation.
cards.subject: CARL + DONUT

cards.headline: Agatha leaves questions behind.
cards.body: Agatha reappears near the staircase with her cart. Zev later reports a brief feed interruption. Carl suspects more is going on, but has no answer.
cards.subject: AGATHA

cards.headline: On to the third floor.
cards.body: Carl waits until the countdown drops below six hours, then heads down with Donut and Mongo. Their next stage is still ahead.
cards.subject: ROYAL COURT

cards.headline: That is a velociraptor.
cards.body: In the epilogue, Odette explains that mongoliensis is the scientific name. The pink-feathered creature Donut adopted is a velociraptor.
cards.subject: MONGO
